releases.body:
opencode-tweaks 0.9.0

- follow the model picked in /models at once, before the next turn

- show a free model's paid list price instead of three zero rates

- add the Free models setting: list price, Free label, or hide the card

opencode-tweaks 0.8.0

- rebuild the model card as a clean rate table

- show the live price multiplier in the card header

- add price alignment and peak-only settings

- drop the model name, provider, and variant the bottom bar already shows

opencode-tweaks 0.7.2

- remove the extra blank line above the model card

- draw the model provider in the same bold text as Quota

opencode-tweaks 0.7.1

- make the model card collapsible like the quota panel

- align the rates and peak state in a small table

- put the provider on the card header

opencode-tweaks 0.7.0

- add a sidebar card with the model's list price

- show input, output, and cache read rates, each optional

- follow the session model, provider, and reasoning variant

- mark the live peak state for DeepSeek and OpenCode Go
